# Ant Design pack

**Implementation skill:** `.agent/skills/ant-design/`

When chosen:

1. Load `skills/ant-design/SKILL.md`
2. Visual language: `references/design-language.md`
3. Specs: `references/spec/*.en-US.md` (layout, forms, feedback, navigation…)
4. Theme: `references/docs/customize-theme.en-US.md`
5. Optional: `@ant-design/cli` / MCP for live component APIs

Best for enterprise admin, dense product UI, tables/forms — not flashy marketing landings (use ui-ux-master brand recipes + optional antd pieces).
